description: A month+day with no year ('October 15') under due-date wording is a real but ambiguous deadline hint — report it as unclear, never claim 'not stated' and never resolve the year silently.

input.text:
CEDAR COUNTY FAMILY SERVICES
DATE: 09/20/2027
It is time to renew your benefits.
The benefits you need to renew have a check-mark next to them:
[x] SNAP
Due dates:
Return the form by October 15.
Items we need from you: send copies.
• Proof of income: last 4 pay stubs.
